title: Widget Test
summary: Reference module showing a custom in-grid widget and its fullscreen canvas view, both from one canvas.js.

sections.heading: What it shows
sections.body: The Level knob draws as a segmented meter supplied by the module itself rather than a built-in dial. Clicking Detail opens the module's own fullscreen view. Both come from the same canvas.js.

sections.heading: For module authors
sections.body: Declare viz: { kind: "custom:<name>" } on a chain_params entry, then export widgetKind and drawCell from canvas.js. Coordinates are frame-local: (0,0) is the knob box, and ctx.width/ctx.height are its size. Values are handed to drawCell; it cannot read params. Schwung keeps drawing the label.

sections.heading: If it does not appear
sections.body: An unknown or broken widget falls back to the built-in graphic rather than leaving a hole, so the page always looks correct. Check debug.log: a widget that threw is disabled for the session and names itself there.
